method: Traced directly from source: mlir_passes/tools/compile-for-target/main.cpp (the real production driver) and mlir_passes/include/FusionPasses.td (pass definitions). Did not assume the '16-pass' figure from the task wording.
driver_pipeline_description_comment_in_s: serving passes (15-pass pipeline)  -- NOTE: this in-source comment is itself stale/inaccurate; the actual PassManager in the same file adds 27 passes, not 15 and not 16.
note_on_registerServingOptimizationPipel: mlir_passes/lib/serving/ServingPipeline.cpp registers a SEPARATE standalone mlir-opt pipeline ('serving-optimization-pipeline', 19 pass invocations: 3 attention + 16 named planning passes) for ad-hoc mlir-opt testing. Its own comment explicitly says 'compile-for-target uses its own PM' -- confirming it is NOT the production path. D2 extends the real compile-for-target PassManager, not this test-only registration.

production_pass_order.purpose: Rewrite raw q/k/v/attention_scores/softmax/kv_cache_read/write pattern into canonical llm.attention_prefill/llm.attention_decode per layer occurrence

production_pass_order.gate: requires an llm.attention_prefill/llm.attention_decode/hir.attention/hir.cpu_attention op in the function body; sets funcOp attr 'serving.policy' only when found
production_pass_order.consumer: ExecutionPlanBuilder::build() only collects a function into plan.function_plans when funcOp has attr 'serving.policy'

production_pass_order.outputs: weight.classification, weight.constant_satisfied per matmul-like op incl. llm.o_proj

production_pass_order.rationale: Runs after every op-level backend/dtype/kernel/weight-classification decision is settled (so it can read real, already-annotated Qwen operator metadata) and before the per-op candidate/plan-selection trio, mirroring QuantizationPlanningPass as the codebase's existing precedent for a module-scoped (Pass<..., mlir::ModuleOp>) whole-model decision distinct from the per-func passes.

production_pass_order.note: The only IR-transforming (non-annotation-only) pass; runs last, after plan selection, before export

downstream_of_pipeline.notes: Collects plan.model_identity, plan.global_decisions, plan.cv_extension unconditionally from module attrs; per-function plan.function_plans entries are gated on funcOp->getAttr('serving.policy'); D2 adds an unconditional plan.distributed collector at the same level as global_decisions/cv_extension

qwen_frontend_paths_available.name: legacy ModelSpec path
qwen_frontend_paths_available.characteristics: hand-templated single op block per phase, never loops over num_layers; per CLAUDE.md this is the legacy/scaffold path being phased out; does not contain an o_proj op at all (only llm.rmsnorm)
qwen_frontend_paths_available.reason_not_used: no o_proj/QKV/MLP projection exists in this path's output to select for TP partitioning

qwen_frontend_paths_available.name: real ONNX per-layer path (target architecture)
qwen_frontend_paths_available.characteristics: full per-layer expansion (24 layers x 2 phases), real serving.layer_index, real llm.o_proj/q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/mlp ops with serving.quantizable=true and real tensor<?x896xf16> shapes
qwen_frontend_paths_available.reason_used: the only path with real, per-layer Qwen operator instances and real static hidden_size=896 to check TP2 legality against, matching D2 Part D's explicit requirement

pre_existing_unrelated_finding.description: LLMFrontendNormalizationPass does not fully consume the raw per-layer attention pattern produced by qwen-onnx-to-serving-mlir: running the real production compile-for-target pipeline on this real per-layer graph leaves 0 llm.attention_prefill/llm.attention_decode ops and 48/48 residual llm.attention_scores ops, so ServingPhaseAnalysisPass's hasServingOp gate never fires and plan.function_plans is empty for this input.
pre_existing_unrelated_finding.confirmed_pre_existing: identical symptom independently reproduced by the pre-existing (D1-baseline-recorded) QwenOnnxServingPlanExportTest ctest failure ('normalized MLIR still contains llm.attention_scores')
pre_existing_unrelated_finding.impact_on_d2: plan.distributed is collected unconditionally at module scope (like global_decisions/cv_extension), independent of the per-function serving.policy gate, so this pre-existing bug does not block D2's distributed plan collection. plan.function_plans is honestly reported as empty for the real-Qwen TP1/TP2 exports produced in this stage; this is documented, not masked.
pre_existing_unrelated_finding.not_fixed_because: fixing LLMFrontendNormalizationPass's attention-pattern rewrite is a large, unrelated MLIR rewrite-pass bug fix, explicitly out of D2's scope (D2 extends the pipeline with a new pass; it does not repair unrelated existing passes)
